snippet.title: Remnant Records - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Remnant Records is a horror investigation game for 1 to 4 players. As the newest recruit of an agency that deals with spirits trapped in the mortal world, explore places haunted by the dead to find clues that will help you reconstruct the tragedies that happened there and free their souls.

Play the beta now! Get your key on the community Discord: discord.gg/Uf8EpWsFts

Coming out in Early Access Q2 2022
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1916310/
Follow on Twitter: https://twitter.com/remnant_records
